notices.text: The M96 is a long-bolt engine: the cylinder head fasteners are long through-bolts that pass through the head and clamp into the crankcase/crankshaft carrier, not short bolts into a deck. Loosen them in reverse sequence in several passes. The OEM through-bolts are TORQUE-TO-YIELD and must be discarded — this is where most builders switch to ARP studs (kit 204-4707) or Raceware. With the heads off, examine the head gasket fire rings for blow-by paths and the coolant ports for corrosion, and photograph both head gaskets in place before lifting them.

fasteners.name: Cylinder head (long) bolts, 996 3.6 — removal

stages.label: Loosen in the reverse of the tightening sequence of WSM Fig. 652_97, in stages.

fasteners.note: Angle-tightened screws; the WSM does not state reuse. Replace.
